We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

The Advanced Analytics and AI Team is at the forefront of leveraging data and AI to transform CIBC’s business operations and deliver strategic value. As a Co-op Student/Intern, People Change Management – Advanced Analytics & AI, you will support initiatives that help employees and stakeholders understand, adopt, and effectively use new data and AI tools, processes, and ways of working. You will gain hands-on experience in change management, communications, learning, stakeholder engagement, and adoption measurement while contributing to high-impact initiatives across the organization.

At CIBC, we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week onsite, while other days will be remote.

How You’ll Succeed

Change Management Support:

You will help develop and maintain practical change management deliverables for advanced analytics and AI initiatives, including stakeholder lists, change impact assessments, engagement plans, readiness activities, and adoption trackers. You will support the team in organizing inputs, identifying themes, and keeping activities on track.

Communications and Learning:

You will support the creation of clear, engaging communications, presentations, job aids, learning materials, and event content that make AI and change topics accessible to different audiences. You will help coordinate learning sessions and gather feedback to improve future activities.

Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination:

You will collaborate with change practitioners, business partners, and technical teams to coordinate meetings, workshops, and engagement activities. You will document decisions and action items, follow up with contributors, and help ensure stakeholders have the information they need.

Research, Insights, and Measurement:

You will conduct research on AI adoption, workforce trends, and change management practices. You will help analyze feedback, participation, and adoption data, identify useful insights, and translate findings into concise updates and recommendations for the team.

Team Contribution:

You will contribute ideas, bring a fresh perspective, and support priority activities across the People Change Management portfolio. You will manage assigned tasks with attention to detail, ask thoughtful questions, and build your knowledge of how change is delivered in a large organization.

Who You Are



- You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree. Your studies are in Business, Change Management, Human Resources, Communications, Organizational Behaviour, Data and Analytics, or a related field, and you are eligible to complete a co-op or internship work term.
- You communicate clearly. You can organize information and create concise, engaging written and visual materials for different audiences.
- You are organized and dependable. You can manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, track details, and follow through on commitments.
- You are curious about people and technology. You are interested in how advanced analytics and AI are changing the way people work and want to learn how thoughtful change management supports adoption.
- You are comfortable working with common business tools. You have experience with PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and collaboration tools. Experience creating communications, analyzing data, or coordinating events or projects is an asset.
- You take initiative and welcome feedback. You are willing to ask questions, learn quickly, and use feedback to strengthen your work.
- You’re driven by collective success. You enjoy working collaboratively, value different perspectives, and contribute to an inclusive team environment.
- Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and live our values—trust, teamwork, and accountability.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential.



- We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive compensation, a banking benefit*, wellbeing support and additional offers such as employee and family assistance programs and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
- Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
- Subject to program terms and conditions

What You Need To Know



- CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
- CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.
- You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit
- We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency). 
- We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.

Job Description 
 Work Arrangement:   
 Hybrid: This internship is categorized as on-site. The selected intern is expected to report to the office 3 days a week. 

 Location:   
 Sunnyvale, CA 

 About the Team 
 Our Mapping organization is building next-generation mapping systems that go beyond static high-definition maps. We use onboard sensor data, algorithms, and machine learning to help reconstruct and maintain maps at scale. These maps support localization, perception, simulation, and autonomous driving.

 The Role
 We’re looking for a Software Engineering Intern to join our Mapping Engineering team. You’ll work with experienced engineers on a scoped project related to map data, geospatial algorithms, or mapping pipeline quality. Depending on the project, you may help process sensor-derived data, improve how map features are represented or validated, or evaluate methods for identifying map changes.

 You’ll receive guidance from a mentor and collaborate with partner teams such as Perception, Localization, and Simulation. This internship is an opportunity to apply your software engineering skills to real-world mapping challenges while learning how research and prototypes become dependable engineering systems.

 What You’ll Do
 
• Contribute to a well-defined mapping or geospatial engineering project, with support from your mentor and team. 
• Write, test, and document code in Python and/or C++ for tasks such as geometry processing, map data analysis, or pipeline tooling. 
• Explore road-network and map concepts, including lanes, intersections, boundaries, connectivity, and map attributes. 
• Help analyze sensor-derived or third-party map data and investigate data quality or map consistency issues. 
• Prototype or evaluate algorithms and machine-learning approaches for feature extraction, map change detection, or map quality checks, as relevant to your project. 
• Build or improve tests, validation tools, metrics, and visualizations to help assess the correctness of map data or software. 
• Share project progress, findings, and a final demo or summary with your mentor and teammates. 
• Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team learning activities. 
 Minimum Qualifications
 
• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, GIS, or a related technical field. 
• Experience programming in Python or C++ through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects. 
• Familiarity with core software engineering practices such as version control, testing, and writing readable code. 
• Foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms. 
• Interest in geospatial systems, robotics, autonomous vehicles, computer vision, or machine learning. 
• Ability to communicate technical ideas, ask questions, and work collaboratively. 
 Preferred Qualifications
 
• Coursework, research, or project experience in geospatial computing, computational geometry, robotics, computer vision, machine learning, or graph algorithms. 
• Exposure to map or geographic data formats and tools such as GeoJSON, OpenStreetMap, GeoPandas, GDAL/OGR, or PostGIS. 
• Experience working with camera, lidar, radar, point-cloud, or other spatial data. 
• Experience with C++ and Python, or an interest in working across both languages. 
• Familiarity with machine-learning workflows such as preparing datasets, evaluating models, or building prototypes. 
• Prior internship, research, or team-project experience developing software collaboratively. 
 Compensation:  
 
• The monthly salary range for this role is $9,600-$11,800 per month   
• GM will provide a one-time lump sum taxable stipend payment to eligible students selected for the 2027 Student Program.  
 What You’ll Get from Us 
 
• Paid U.S. GM holidays. 
• GM Family First Vehicle Discount Program. 
• Potential for growth within GM based on performance and business needs. 
• Intern events and opportunities to network with company leaders and peers. 
• Mentorship and hands-on experience with the data and ML foundations behind autonomy 




 About GM 
 Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.
 
 Why Join Us  
 We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.
 
 Benefits Overview 
 From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources .
 
 Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.) 
 General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.
 
 All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws. 
 
 We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit How we Hire .
 
 Accommodations 
 General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.
